    18	public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic
    19	public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Lattice
    20	public import Mathlib.Order.Filter.AtTopBot.Defs
    21	
    22	@[expose] public section
    23	
    24	variable {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    25	
    26	open scoped List
    27	
    28	/-- The set of subset sums of a set `A ⊆ M`. -/
    29	def subsetSums (A : Set M) : Set M :=
    30	  {n | ∃ B : Finset M, ↑B ⊆ A ∧ n = ∑ i ∈ B, i}
    31	
    32	/-- If `A ⊆ B`, then `subsetSums A ⊆ subsetSums B`. -/
    33	@[gcongr]
    34	theorem subsetSums_mono {A B : Set M} (h : A ⊆ B) : subsetSums A ⊆ subsetSums B :=
    35	  fun _ ⟨C, hC⟩ => ⟨C, hC.1.trans h, hC.2⟩
    36	
    37	/-- The set of subset sums of a sequence `ℕ → M`, where repetition is allowed. -/
    38	def subseqSums' (A : ℕ → M) : Set M :=
    39	  {n | ∃ B : Finset ℕ, n = ∑ i ∈ B, A i}
    40	
    41	variable [Preorder M]
    42	
    43	/-- A set `A ⊆ M` is complete if every sufficiently large element of `M` is a subset sum of `A`. -/
    44	def IsAddComplete (A : Set M) : Prop :=
    45	  ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, k ∈ subsetSums A
    46	
    47	/-- If `A ⊆ B` and `A` is complete, then `B` is also complete. -/
    48	@[gcongr]
    49	theorem IsAddComplete.mono {A B : Set M} (h : A ⊆ B) (ha : IsAddComplete A) : IsAddComplete B := by
    50	  filter_upwards [ha] with x hx
    51	  exact (subsetSums_mono h) hx
    52	
    53	/-- A set `A ⊆ M` is complete if every sufficiently large element of `M` is a subset sum of `A`. -/
    54	def IsAddStronglyComplete (A : Set M) : Prop :=
    55	  ∀ ⦃B : Set M⦄, B.Finite → IsAddComplete (A \ B)
    56	
    57	/-- A strongly complete set is complete. -/
    58	theorem IsAddStronglyComplete.isAddComplete {A : Set M} (hA : IsAddStronglyComplete A) :
    59	    IsAddComplete A := by simpa using hA Set.finite_empty
    60	
    61	/-- If `A ⊆ B` and `A` is strongly complete, then `B` is also strongly complete. -/
    62	theorem IsAddStronglyComplete.mono {A B : Set M} (h : A ⊆ B) (ha : IsAddStronglyComplete A) :
    63	    IsAddStronglyComplete B := fun C hC => (ha hC).mono (by grind)
    64	
    65	/-- A sequence `A` is strongly complete if `fun m => A (n + m)` is still complete for all `n`. -/
    66	def IsAddStronglyCompleteNatSeq (A : ℕ → M) : Prop :=
    67	  ∀ n, IsAddComplete (Set.range (fun m => A (n + m)))
    68	
    69	/-- A strongly complete sequence is complete. -/
    70	theorem IsAddStronglyCompleteNatSeq.isAddComplete {A : ℕ → M}
    71	    (hA : IsAddStronglyCompleteNatSeq A) :
    72	    IsAddComplete (Set.range A) := by simpa using hA 0
    73	
    74	open scoped Classical in
    75	/-- If the range of a sequence `A` is strongly complete, then `A` is strongly complete. -/
    76	theorem IsAddStronglyCompleteNatSeq.of_isAddStronglyComplete {A : ℕ → M}
    77	    (h : IsAddStronglyComplete (.range A)) : IsAddStronglyCompleteNatSeq A :=
    78	  fun n => (h (Finset.finite_toSet _)).mono (A := .range A \ ((Finset.range n).image A))
    79	    (fun _ ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, q⟩ => ⟨y - n, by grind⟩)
    80	
    81	/-- If `A` is strongly complete and the preimage of each element is finite, then the range of `A`
    82	is strongly complete. -/
    83	theorem IsAddStronglyCompleteNatSeq.isAddStronglyComplete {A : ℕ → M}
    84	    (h : IsAddStronglyCompleteNatSeq A) (hA : ∀ m, (A ⁻¹' {m}).Finite) :
    85	    IsAddStronglyComplete (.range A) := by
    86	  refine fun B hB => ?_
    87	  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Finset.exists_nat_subset_range (hB.preimage' (fun b _ => hA b)).toFinset
    88	  rw [Set.Finite.toFinset_subset, Finset.coe_range] at hn
    89	  refine (h (n + 1)).mono ?_
    90	  refine fun x ⟨y, hy⟩ => ⟨⟨n + 1 + y, hy⟩, fun hx => ?_⟩
    91	  have : n + 1 + y ∈ Set.Iio n := by grind
    92	  grind
    93	
    94	/-- A sequence `A` is complete if every sufficiently large element of `M` is a sum of
    95	(not necessarily distinct) terms of `A`. -/
    96	def IsAddCompleteNatSeq' (A : ℕ → M) : Prop :=
    97	  ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, k ∈ subseqSums' A
